The '''ion carbine''' was a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-like weapon designed primarily to disable [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. As with other ion weapons, it fired ion energy which disrupted electrical systems, but was not very effective against organic targets. It was similar to an [[Ion rifle/Legends|ion rifle]], however it had the advantage of shooting in autofire mode, that is, rapid automatic fire, allowing the user to take down several droids at once.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

The [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] saw the rise of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], which compelled the creation of advanced ion weaponry such as the ion carbine.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> Sometimes these weapons were given to combat droids in order to fight against other combat droids.<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
